source.coordinateSystem: X right, Y up, Z toward viewer
source.scope: Bounded secondary control curves. Browser rig owns primary pose, bone lengths and contact constraints.

draw.intent: Attention leads; hand prepares; fixed contact is preserved; wrist lifts before recovery.

repair.intent: Attention returns, left hand prepares first, right hand takes a shorter path, then releases.

rise.intent: Forward preparation precedes standing; pelvis and feet remain owned by the IK rig; chest/head settle last.
